title: Fewer, Deeper Fixes
kind: the team's review: Matthew Keenan's reply to report 048, Matthew Hammer's replies, and a response point by point; work in progress
question: Matthew Keenan, on Slack 2026-11-09, read report 048's ledger of costs and asked for a few well-chosen fixes rather than many separate ones. Where does the series' evidence agree with each of his points, and which few fixes would address the most costs? Matthew Hammer, 2026-11-10: "Let's write a report with this feedback, and our reasoned response to it."
measurements: No new measurement of the app, except build 45's marks: the point-by-point numbers are report 048's ledger (048/data/ledger.json), each checked against the report it cites. Build 45's statics are from one run of the Firefox check (scripts/jit_slides.py in jit.yml, hazelgrove/hazel, GitHub's machines) on the Witch slide, steps 1 to 4, against build 43's run.
builds: Numbered as in reports 050 to 052: build N is the build before it plus one change, on trial/694-view-jit; builds 44 and 45 were checked on trial/694-view-jit-35. The builds table names commit and run.
